# JKKN College of Arts and Science

> Autonomous college (2024-25 to 2028-29) affiliated to Periyar University, Salem, accredited by NAAC with Grade B (CGPA 2.37), offering 32 UG, PG and PhD programmes (3 more proposed) in Arts, Science and Commerce. Located on NH-544, Komarapalayam, Namakkal district, near Erode, Tamil Nadu 638183, India.

<!-- version: 2026-11-21 -->
<!-- canonical: https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/ -->
<!-- full reference: https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/llms-full.txt -->

## About

JKKN College of Arts and Science (CAS JKKN) is an autonomous college established in 1974 as part of J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions (founded 1952). The college is spread across 15 acres on the Salem-Coimbatore Highway (NH-544) and serves 1,516 students (NIRF 2026 submission, AY 2024-25). It is affiliated to Periyar University, Salem, recognised by UGC under Section 2(f) and 12(B), and accredited by NAAC with Grade B (CGPA 2.37). It was originally named Alamelu Angappan College for Women and became co-educational in 2008. It declares itself a donation-free institution offering merit-based admissions (NAAC Self Study Report, cycle 1).

## Key Facts

- Founded: 1974 (the J.K.K. Nattraja group dates from 1952) - source: UGC list of colleges under Section 2(f) & 12(B), https://www.ugc.gov.in/colleges
- Status: Autonomous, conferred with effect from 2024-25, valid 2024-25 to 2028-29 - source: UGC List of Approved Autonomous Colleges as on 30 June 2026 (entry 1556), https://www.ugc.gov.in/pdfnews/8688705_List-of-Autonomous-Colleges.pdf
- Affiliation: Periyar University, Salem - source: https://www.periyaruniversity.ac.in/Affiliated_Colleges.php
- UGC recognition: Section 2(f) and 12(B) of the UGC Act
- Accreditation: NAAC Grade B, CGPA 2.37, first cycle, declared 9 August 2019, valid up to 31 December 2029 - source: NAAC list of institutions having valid accreditation (as on 14 August 2025) and NAAC extension of validity for Transition Autonomous Colleges
- Campus: 15 acres, Komarapalayam, Namakkal District
- Students: 1,516 (UG 1,238 + PG 278; NIRF 2026 submission, AY 2024-25)
- Faculty: 110 on roll, 52 with a Ph.D. (NIRF 2026 submission)
- Codes: AISHE C-9494; NIRF IR-C-C-9494; TN DCE college code 2180001
- All approvals with their official documents: https://cas.jkkn.ac.in/approvals
- Programmes: 32 approved - UG 19, PG 10, Ph.D. 3 (aided and self-financing streams counted separately) - plus 3 proposed UG programmes awaiting Periyar University approval
- Location: NH-544, between Salem and Coimbatore
- Nearest towns and cities (approx. road distance): Bhavani (~8 km), Pallipalayam (~14 km), Sankagiri (~16 km), Erode (~18 km), Tiruchengode (~26 km), Perundurai (~29 km), Gobichettipalayam (~37 km), Salem (~57 km), Rasipuram (~60 km), Namakkal (~65 km)

## Programmes Offered

- B.A. History
- B.Com.
- B.Sc. Chemistry
- B.Sc. Mathematics
- B.Sc. Zoology

- B.C.A.
- B.Com. (Computer Applications)

- B.Sc. Mathematics
- B.Sc. Microbiology
- B.Sc. Physics

### Doctoral (Ph.D.)

- Ph.D. Zoology

## Parent Organization

J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions — a multi-institution educational group comprising 7 colleges and 2 schools including Dental, Pharmacy, Nursing, Engineering, Allied Health Sciences, Education, and two schools (Matriculation HSS and CBSE).

- [Group website](https://jkkn.ac.in): J.K.K. Nattraja Educational Institutions

## Facilities

- Multi-specialty teaching hospital on the group campus
- Central library with digital access
- Computer labs with modern infrastructure
- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- Sports complex with indoor stadium and gymnasium
- Transport from Erode, Salem, Namakkal and surrounding areas
- Food court and bank/post office on campus
